confidence_notes: The FX figure is the latest RBA observation found by search (18 Nov 2026). Food and drink anchors come from crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (Almurakib, CityCost), which disagree somewhat. I did one price search, not the five allowed. Wine and cocktail were not found directly, so I set them from the usual Japanese ratio to beer (cocktail about 1.6x, wine about 1.7x). Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against listings. Tottori has few hostels, so the hostel figures are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tottori is a small regional Japanese city. I used Tottori-specific crowdsourced prices and scaled them against Tokyo and other regional Japanese cities.
